summary: Iteration 25: tested 4 new features — (1) exam managers/co-gestionnaires, (2) availability windows (plages horaires), (3) bulk export of annotated PDFs (merged PDF + ZIP) for document/inline/PDF exams, (4) sticky annotator toolbar. Backend pytest 11/11 PASSED. Frontend e2e all PASSED: builder managers picker + windows editor (validation error shown, save persists, dashboard shows 'Hors plage · 15 mars 2030 · 9 h 30 → 11 h 00'); manager login sees 'Géré · Lynch S.' badge, no delete button, can open Suivi and Modifier; merged PDF = 6 pages (separator + 2 pages per student, annotations rendered), ZIP = 2 per-student PDFs with names+matricule; buttons hidden on non-inline exams (FRA401); student toolbar stays stuck at y=64 under 65px header after scroll; landing shows 403 toast 'Prochaine ouverture : 15 mars 2030 à 9 h 30.'

minor.issue: No server-side validation of windows: invalid entries (end<=start, unparsable) are silently dropped by window_state; an exam with only invalid windows becomes always open. Frontend still allows saving the invalid row (shows red error but save is not blocked).

Resumable-session lookup uses the raw typed name/number BEFORE roster normalization (match_roster). For class exams, a student who typed a name variant (accents/case-insensitive match) or omitted matricule would be refused reconnection once the window closes, even though they have an in_progress session. Move the window check after roster resolution.

Managers can edit the managers list (add/remove other managers, add the owner). Acceptable per spec 'mêmes droits', but consider restricting managers/ownership-related fields to owner. sync_bank also files the manager's edits into the manager's own question bank (user['id']) rather than the owner's — probably fine, just note.

ui_bugs.issue: excludeId={form.teacher_id || user?.id} but form is built only from FIELDS (EMPTY keys) so form.teacher_id is always undefined. When a manager edits, the owner (Lynch S.) appears as a checkable manager and the manager themself is hidden. Add teacher_id to loaded form (not to payload) or keep exam.teacher_id in a separate state.

issues: Uses native browser <input type='datetime-local'> (shown in US mm/dd/yyyy AM/PM format in English locale browsers) rather than a shadcn Calendar + time picker; inconsistent with French UI.
Save not blocked when a window row is invalid.
Managers picker and help-recipients picker list every teacher (~20 rows each) — very long page; consider a searchable combobox.

action_items: Fix ExamBuilder managers picker excludeId (form.teacher_id is undefined) so the owner is excluded when a manager edits
Do the window/resumable check in /student/join after roster normalization for class exams
Validate windows server-side (reject end<=start / unparsable) and block save in UI when a row is invalid
Optional: replace datetime-local with shadcn date/time picker in French format
